name: Noopept

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A proline-containing dipeptide developed as a racetam-adjacent nootropic and registered in Russia. It is not an approved drug or a lawful dietary ingredient in the United States. Registered in Russia. No FDA approval and not a lawful US dietary ingredient.

Oral compound with first-pass exposure and no US safety labelling.
